Treat Bouquet (Korean:축하스틱다발, chughaseutigdabal, "Bundle of Celebration Sticks") is Twinsticks's first Costume, released in the first half of the Sweet School Band! update. It is an Epic Costume that can only be obtained through a Pet Costume package in the Package Shop.

Story

Twinsticks is decked out in bouquet wrapping, waiting for Sweet Punch backstage after their concert! It prepared this special surprise with the help of family and friends. Seeing the Cookies' happy smiles in their InstraCrumb pictures with Twinsticks makes the surprise seem like a big success.

Trivia

  • Treat Bouquet was released alongside  Sweet Punch Solo Concert,  Little Deviant, and  Purple Dip.
  • Treat Bouquet, as well as  Sweet Punch Solo Concert,  Little Deviant,  Purple Dip,  Train Conductor, and  Train Attendant, used a different name format, having the name of the costume come before the costume owner, i.e, Treat Bouquet Twinsticks.
    • This error was fixed in the subsequent update.
